notes.text: The copy language w#w — provably IMPOSSIBLE for any pushdown automaton: a stack hands back what it stored in reverse. A queue preserves order, so verifying a perfect copy is effortless: enqueue the left half, then match each symbol against the queue front.
ab#ab is accepted; ab#ba — the string a STACK would accept — is rejected. Acceptance: empty queue + input consumed.

meta.title: Perfect copy: w#w
meta.blurb: Accepts w#w — an exact repetition. No PDA can do this (stacks reverse), but FIFO order makes it natural: the queue front always holds the next symbol the copy must produce.
